parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
